# Introduction

Greydwarf brutes are aggressive creatures found in Black Forests. They are large mossy tree-like beings and are substantially bigger and stronger than Greydwarfs.

### Drops

• Item: Ancient seed | 0 Star: 33% | 1 Star: 2 (66%) | 2 Star: 4

• Item: Dandelion | 0 Star: 1 | 1 Star: 2 | 2 Star: 4

• Item: Greydwarf Brute trophy | 0 Star: 10% | 1 Star: 10% | 2 Star: 10%

• Item: Greydwarf eye | 0 Star: 2 (50%) | 1 Star: 4 | 2 Star: 8

• Item: Stone | 0 Star: 2 | 1 Star: 4 | 2 Star: 8

• Item: Wood | 0 Star: 3-4 | 1 Star: 6-8 | 2 Star: 12-16

### Spawning

• Type: Anywhere in Black Forest during the nighttime, despawn at dawn | Limit: 1 | Frequency: Common | Stars: After 2000 meters from the world center

• Type: Anywhere in Meadows during the nighttime after defeating The Elder, despawn at dawn | Limit: 1 | Frequency: Common | Stars: No

• Type: Rare spawn point near some abandoned structures in Black Forest | Limit: - | Frequency: One time | Stars: Yes

• Type: Rarely from Greydwarf nests in Black Forest | Limit: 3 | Frequency: 12 seconds | Stars: Yes

• Type: During "The forest is moving..." event before defeating The Elder | Limit: 1 | Frequency: Very common | Stars: No

### Attack

Slams their rock downwards, extending outwards 3 meters in a 45-degree vertical arc (30 Slash damage). This attack can be used every 2 seconds when within 1.8 meters of a player.

## Notes

• One-star Greydwarf brutes have pinker bark than the standard Greydwarf brute's brown. Two-star Greydwarf brutes have even more vivid-pink bark.
• Brutes deal slash damage despite them having a club shaped arm as a weapon, this is due to the alpha version of the Brute attacking with normal claws and their damage type has not been changed to reflect their new weapon.
